name: ssssssssssss
query:
select
    tabItem.item_code as "Item:Link/Item:100",
    tabItem.item_name as "Item Name::200",
    tabItem.brand as "Brand::100",
    (tabBin.valuation_rate*(select sum(tabBin.actual_qty) from tabBin where tabItem.item_code = tabBin.item_code)) as "Total Value:Currency:150",
    tabBin.valuation_rate as "Valuation Rate:Currency:150",
    (select sum(tabBin.actual_qty) from tabBin where tabItem.item_code = tabBin.item_code) as "Total QTY:FLOAT:100",
    (select sum(tabBin.actual_qty) from tabBin inner join tabWarehouse on tabWarehouse.name = tabBin.warehouse where tabItem.item_code = tabBin.item_code and tabWarehouse.summery_stock = 1) as "Summery QTY:FLOAT:100",
    (select sum(tabBin.actual_qty) from tabBin inner join tabWarehouse on tabWarehouse.name = tabBin.warehouse where tabItem.item_code = tabBin.item_code and tabWarehouse.summery_stock = 0) as "Not Summery QTY:FLOAT:100"
from 
    `tabItem` join `tabBin` on `tabItem`.name = `tabBin`.item_code 
where
    tabItem.brand = %(brand)s
    and `tabBin`.warehouse = "المخزن الرئيسي - IBC"
